method.choices: Each named branch starts with its rank-one ability (an unlocked starting ability) and prioritizes that branch among actual random offers, then common sustain/damage. Base policies start without an ability. Other compatible branches can appear as lower-priority legal fallback choices. Entry and exit ranks are recorded.
method.controls: Same eight-direction physical-key controller for all classes at 12 Hz, 120 Hz combat, actual collisions and telegraph avoidance. Sword/dagger stand at their real reach; bow/staff aim at 205 pixels. Comet dashes offensively inside 125 pixels and uses only available charges. Ranger trap evasion remains passive in the unmodified hazard code. Other classes emergency-dash below 42 pixels.
method.damage_definition: Sum of actual HP removed by accepted damage_player calls, after armor/invulnerability and capped at remaining HP on lethal hits; healing does not subtract from this counter.
method.limitations: Small seeded automated sample; exact telegraph knowledge favors the controller. Approximate movement may stall and fixed 240-second observations retain living timeouts. Healthy-entry and stress encounters do not establish prior-stage survival, campaign completion, human win rates, or definitive class balance. Natural campaign observations are separately marked.
method.matching: Every branch uses the identical listed seed and target-stage arena seed; map geometry, initial roster and stage match. Legal class progression, random reward pools and later RNG consumption naturally differ.
method.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 240-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
method.progression: Independent healthy-entry encounters: preceding stages supply their exact total dropped XP and legal random three-option rewards. HP is set to normal maximum at entry. No injected kills or HP changes in measured combat; this is not a prior-stage survival result.
method.shield_measurement: Damage counter is actual health lost after shield absorption; shield left is reported separately. This counter is not incoming raw damage or total effective damage.
method.version: v7 actual combat; inherits v6 movement/navigation and measurement
